jobs.occupation: Instrument Scientist (m/w/d) (Physiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description: Technical University Munich operates the high flux Neutron Source Heinz Maier-Leibnitz (FRM II) located at the scientific campus in Garching, Germany. The neutron source itself, its research instruments as well as the irradiation facilities provide unique possibilities for the scientific and industrial use of neutron beams.In the group Neutron Imaging, we are offering a full-time scientist position (40 hours / week) asInstrument Scientist Neutron Imaging (m/f/d)The Neutron Imaging Group at the FRM II operates two world-leading instruments, ANTARES and NECTAR, providing complementary capabilities for radiography and tomography with neutrons. The group plays a key role in advancing methodological development in neutron imaging worldwide.ANTARES is a versatile imaging instrument using thermal and cold neutrons for a broad range of radiography and tomography applications. NECTAR can switch between thermal- and fast-neutron operation and offers worldwide unique capabilities for fast-neutron imaging, enabling the investigation of large and highly absorbing samples that are difficult to access with conventional neutron or X-ray imaging. In recent years, multimodal imaging approaches combining neutron imaging with complementary imaging and characterization techniques have gained increasing importance for the quantitative characterization of materials and functional systems. The complementary capabilities of ANTARES and NECTAR provide an excellent basis for developing and applying such approaches.You will work across our neutron imaging activities at ANTARES and NECTAR, with a particular focus on fast-neutron imaging and the operation and further development of NECTAR. Your tasks includeImplementation and commissioning of advanced neutron imaging methodologies, with a particular focus on fast-neutron imaging at NECTAR.Support of user operation and scientific experiments at ANTARES and NECTAR, with a primary focus on NECTAR.Development of multimodal and multi-probe imaging approaches, exploiting complementary information provided by thermal and fast neutrons, gamma rays, and other complementary techniques.Development of image processing, reconstruction and data analysis workflows for quantitative and multimodal imaging applications.Contribution to technical reports, instrument documentation and procedures.Development of an active scientific research profile and establishment of new collaborations in neutron imaging.Acquisition and development of collaborative research projects and contribution to research proposals.PhD in physics, engineering, materials science, computer science, imaging science, or a related field.Strong background in neutron imaging, X-ray imaging, tomography, image processing, computer vision, or related experimental techniques.Hands-on experience with experimental techniques, including data acquisition, instrumentation, or experimental setups.Experience with scientific programming and data analysis (e.g. Python, C++, MATLAB).Experience in image reconstruction, quantitative image analysis, machine learning, or multimodal data fusion is highly desirable.Experience with neutron scattering or large-scale research facilities is beneficial.Self-motivated and independent working style combined with the ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary team.Excellent communication skills in English; German language skills are beneficial.Willingness to work in a controlled area in a research reactor environment.Demonstrated ability to conduct independent scientific research and motivation to develop an own scientific research profile.For further information about the position, please contact Robin Woracek, E-Mail: Robin.Woracek@frm2.tum.de . The high safety standard of our facility requires the reliability of the employees according to German nuclear law. Appropriate reliability checks have to be performed for all employees.We offer flexible working hours, ...

If so, we invite you to explore an exciting opportunity within Siemens Advanta's Professional Services organization, specifically in our AI & New Technologies practice!What we offer you- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- Barrier-free locationsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.Your role as a senior consultant in Artificial IntelligenceAs senior consultants in AI and new Technologies we deliver value reaching from concepts and strategies to code, proof of values and productive solutions. We are looking for senior consultants that build on a foundation of genAI and agentic systems and provide a skill spike in either Data Science or Industrial AI, and are passionate about applying AI to solve real-world operational challenges.- Shape the development of cross-functional projects with consultants, domain experts, and clients to design and implement agentic systems and solve complex industrial challenges. You will take ownership, develop and architect solutions that leverage foundation models and multi-agent frameworks to advance our customers’ AI Strategy and processes. - Lead client conversations and translate complex operational and business requirements into project approaches and technical solutions- Develop production-grade code and implement AI solutions, collaborating with third-party developers to program reliable and scalable features in OT & IT integrated environments. Help design the overall architecture for enterprise and industrial AI solutions.- Communicate results to stakeholders of all seniority levels – from top management to plant operators & end users – ensuring clear understanding of AI's impact on industrial and enterprise processes.- Act as a key innovator and thought leader in our practice, prototyping novel solutions that demonstrate the transformative power of agentic and AI technologies.- Enjoy project-related travel and work on exciting challenges at our customer’s sites.Your defining qualities- Education:  Outstanding academic degree (Master’s/Diploma/PhD) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields, complemented by a strong specialization in Data Science, Machine Learning or Data Engineering - Hard-Skills: Proven experience in building and deploying GenAI applications and with one or more agentic AI frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agents SDK) to create and integrate AI agent. Proficiency in Python for data analytics, automation, and AI development and Cloud Platform expertise (focus: Azure, incl. Microsoft Foundry). Knowledge of Data Warehousing & Engineering (focus: Snowflake & dbt)- Experience: 3+ years of work relevant work experience in a consultancy, a renowned industrial or tech company, or a start-up and a proven track record of excellence in consulting, customer facing and with data and AI in relevant domains. - Domain:  Hands-on experience and demonstrated ownership with AI applied to business or industrial data (e.g., time series, process optimization, document intelligence) and IT/OT architecture experience and knowledge of industrial standards- Personality: Strong drive, entrepreneurial and innovation mindset ready to take responsibility and ownership in a growing organization. A high degree of curiosity and willingness to learn, social skills and team spirit as well as communication skills in EnglishIf you do not check all the boxes but are convinced to be able to contribute and deliver a data driven project, please feel encouraged to apply.Your individual personality and perspective are important to us. Diversity along all dimensions builds the basis for shaping sustainable, creative, and value-added solutions that truly matters to our clients. We are very much looking forward to getting to know you via your application.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About the Artificial Intelligence & New Technologies (AI&NT) practiceAt AI&NT, we are at the cutting edge of digital transformation. As the vibrant heart of Siemens Advanta, our diverse collective of 40+ digitally native professionals proudly speaks 20+ languages across regions and cultures. Our strength lies in bridging cutting-edge innovation with real-world applicability.We pioneer technology and drive change in our customers’ AI transformation journey towards AI native companies in industry. We empower Siemens and its clients to achieve measurable business value and transformational change by:- Turning Data, AI and Agentic Systems into customer solutions- Defining Enterprise-wide Data & AI Strategies- Building Strong Foundational OT & IT Architectures- Designing Operating Models and Change FrameworkWe bring deep expertise to our clients in genAI and Agentic Systems, ML & AI Algorithms, IT and Data Architectures, OT Systems & Industrial Automation, Software Development, & Cybersecurity. This enables us to shape our customers’ transformation towards AI Native companies impacting AI strategy, innovations, and new businesses.Thinking and acting as ONE Tech Company, we represent Siemens and help our customers transform from strategy to implementation by combining the power of Advanta’s professional services and Siemens’ comprehensive portfolio and deep domain expertise. This is how we bring innovation to life, drive digital transformation, and unlock sustainable value for our clients at global scale, especially within the dynamic industrial sector.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Digital Strategy & Customer Success Manager (f/m/d), you drive the digital and AI strategy for Siemens Energy Procurement and ensure the delivery of measurable business value. You connect procurement needs with digital opportunities, translate them into strategic initiatives, and support their successful execution. Working closely with internal customers and cross-functional teams, you gather insights, monitor adoption, and continuously enhance the digital portfolio. You bridge strategy and execution to accelerate procurement transformation and customer success.How You’ll Make an Impact * Shape and continuously evolve Procurement’s digital and AI strategy, translating business priorities, Procurement challenges, technology trends and customer needs into strategic priorities, target pictures and actionable roadmaps* Connect strategic and operational Procurement with digital transformation, identifying opportunities where digital, AI and new ways of working can simplify processes, improve decisions and create measurable business value* Drive strategic initiatives from concept toward execution, developing recommendations, business cases and decision papers and translating strategic priorities into pragmatic initiatives together with Procurement and DTO stakeholders* Drive Customer Success for strategic digital initiatives and products, building strong relationships with internal customers, understanding their outcomes, challenges and emerging needs, and ensuring that strategic ambition translates into sustainable business value* Use customer insights, adoption, business outcomes and market developments to challenge and improve our direction, creating a systematic feedback loop between Procurement reality, digital products, the portfolio and DTO strategy* Collaborate across DTO and Procurement to connect strategy with execution, particularly with Transformation & Customer Success, Product Management, Rollout and other teams, ensuring alignment from strategic intent through adoption and value realizationWhat You Bring* Extensive years of relevant experience in strategic and/or operational Procurement, with a strong understanding of Procurement processes, business priorities, user needs and the practical realities of a global Procurement organization* Experience in digital strategy, business transformation, strategy consulting, product management, Customer Success or comparable strategic initiatives, ideally connecting strategy development with practical implementation* Strong ability to bridge strategy and execution, translating complex strategic objectives, business requirements and digital opportunities into pragmatic roadmaps, initiatives and measurable outcomes* Understanding of digital products, AI-enabled transformation and Customer Success, including how customer needs, adoption, feedback and value realization can inform product and strategic decisions* Strong analytical and business capabilities, with experience structuring complex topics, developing business cases, management recommendations, KPIs and executive decision support* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills in German and English, with the ability to connect Procurement, leadership, digital and technology stakeholders and build trusted relationships across organizational levelsAbout the TeamIn our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbaticalWe value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

ensure that our governance meets EU regulatory expectations (DORA, the EU AI Act, GDPR), and partner closely with legal, data, platform engineering and business teamsWhat you bringEssential- A track record of building and scaling a capability or operating model across a large, complex organisation - ideally in data governance, data management, knowledge management or AI enablement - coaching and influencing teams that retain ownership, rather than relying on formal authority- Data governance and regulatory knowledge (DORA, EU AI Act, GDPR) and how these apply to the use of data by AI- A good understanding of data modelling and semantics / ontologies, and why they matter for making data AI-ready- Conceptual fluency in generative AI and retrieval, sufficient to design and govern how AI consumes context (building the pipelines is done by platform engineering)- Familiarity with a modern data platform such as Databricks / Unity Catalog - governance, lineage, classification and metadata- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and enablement - able to make technical concepts accessible and to build adoption across business and technical teamsDesirable- Experience in asset management or financial services- Experience standing up and scaling a governance, knowledge or enablement capability- Hands-on experience with ontology tooling and metadata / catalogue platforms and/or data contextWhat we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- Volunteering time- … and so much more!

Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. To Recruitment Agencies:Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.108429 | Data & AI | Professional | n.a. | Allianz Global Investors | Full-Time | PermanentAs a Data Quality Expert (f/m/d), you will support the development (Change) and operation (Run) of data quality tooling and the management of data quality metadata. This hybrid engineering and business analysis role combines Databricks development, DQ platform support, stakeholder engagement and the responsibility of the AllianzGI data dashboards.This position will be based in Munich or Frankfurt.What you will doDQI — a data product for storing, standardising and visualising all data-quality-related metadataBuild:- Gap assessment across data quality platforms providing source metadata- Support data modelling activities within the scope of the data product- Develop pipelines for new and existing metadata load interfacesOperate:- Business analysis for new metadata source onboarding- Technical evaluation of new datasets onboarding- Resolve pipeline failures and provide technical support- Bug analysis for DQI data issuesData Quality Tooling — enterprise-wide data quality toolBuild:- Support the migration of the in-house data quality platform to the native Databricks DQX framework- Implement new attributes / features for DQ needs- Build enhancements from new business requirementsOperate:- Support the check lifecycle: create, modify and deactivate checks- Monitor DQ KPIs; drive quality improvement- Support onboarding of new applications & data productsData DashboardBuild:- Build enhancements from new business requirements and dashboard itemsOperate:- Run and maintain the data quality dashboards for AGI in close alignment with stakeholdersPrimary areas of ownership, drawing on Databricks engineering skills to support the build and operation of the DQ platform:- Demand Management: Capture, assess and prioritize new Data Quality requirements from Data Products and future consumers.- DQ Rule Design: Support the design of data quality controls, including check definitions (title, priority and remediation protocol), schedules and code (the technical script).- Consumer Onboarding & Support: Onboard new data products and business functions to the data quality platform; provide training, technical support and access management; and connect new sources.- Governance & Roadmap Management: Support the DQI roadmap, prioritize demand, manage stakeholder expectations, and ensure alignment with enterprise data strategy and regulatory requirements.- DQ Operations Monitoring: Monitor execution of data quality schedules, jobs and checks on the Databricks platform; investigate failures, missing executions, abnormal trends and technical incidents.- Platform Administration: Manage users, permissions, environments, schedules, configurations, and operational parameters of the DQI platform.- Platform Change & Release Management: Deliver platform upgrades, enhancements and bug fixes; coordinate testing, deployment and production releases while minimizing business disruption.- Integration Management: Maintain integration with additional DQ platforms.- Dashboard & Reporting: Develop and maintain DQ dashboards, KPI reporting and management scorecards.What you bring- Hands-on Databricks development experience (pipelines, notebooks, jobs) — the DQ platform runs on Databricks- Familiarity with the DQX framework or equivalent data quality rule/check frameworks- Strong business analysis skills — able to translate DQ requirements into rule definitions and technical specifications- Stakeholder management — comfortable working across Data Products, business functions and platform/engineering teams- Good understanding or willingness to learn on Microsoft Power BI- Root-cause analysis — investigating DQ findings, pipeline failures and technical incidents- Experience with data modelling and metadata management best practices- Understanding of DQ operations: check lifecycle management, KPI monitoring and continuous improvement- Experience with Agile methodologies- Knowledge of AI/Data Strategy, Data Cleaning, Data Governance desiredWhat we offer- We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)- Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans- Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)- Company share purchasing plan- Mental health and wellbeing programs- Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)- Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group- Self-guided learning & development- Volunteering time- … and so much more!

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Strategy Consultant (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: Ready to shape strategy where it matters? As a (Senior) Strategy Consultant (f/m/d), you'll take on real responsibility from your first project - from concept to implementation across industries like Automotive & Batteries, Consumer Packaged Goods, Electronics & Semiconductor, Life Sciences and Power Utilities. Backed by Siemens technologies, you'll solve complex problems where strategy meets the real-world and make your mark both for our clients and within Siemens itself.What we offer you- Attractive remuneration package- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date- Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvementSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You'll make an impact by- Owning complex workstreams end-to-end. You grasp unfamiliar problems quickly, structure them efficiently, and develop recommendations tailored to what the client actually needs.**  **- Building AI into the answer, not next to it. Agentic systems, industrial copilots, and applied analytics are core to what clients ask us for. You judge where they create measurable value and where they don't, and you make that case to a skeptical board.**  **- Keeping projects firmly on course. You build relationships with mid- to senior-level stakeholders, understand what drives them, and hold the line on priorities when the ground shifts mid-project**. **- Seeing your work go live. Because implementation sits under the same roof, your recommendations move from slide to pilot to rollout, across our industry units.**  **- Acting as a team role model. You mentor junior colleagues on analytical techniques, give feedback that helps them grow, and shape how we work rather than only what we deliver.- Shaping Siemens from within. Alongside client projects, you take on transformation topics inside Siemens, a perspective on industrial transformation you won't get from client work alone.** **This is how you'll win us over- **Consulting experience: **3-5 years in strategy consulting, with a proven track record of leading workstreams and managing client relationships independently.- **Academic Excellence: Strong Master's, Ph.D., or MBA with a quantitative or technical core, or from a top business school. **- AI in practice: AI is embedded in your daily work and problem-solving approach. You instinctively judge where technology creates real business value and where it doesn’t. Hands-on experience with agents, LLM applications, or data products is a big plus.- Global Mindset: International exposure gained through studies, internships, or work experience abroad.** **- Analytical skills: Ability to build defensible recommendations on incomplete data and explicitly state underlying assumptions.** **- Empathetic Leadership: Demonstrated experience guiding junior colleagues and actively fostering their professional growth.** **- **Languages Proficiency: Fluent German (min. C1) and English (min. C1), both required. Many of our client discussions happen in German, so English alone is not sufficient for this role. **You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers.With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain.Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 people across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.
